svg.text: One process and one receive thread. Only two modules are permitted to touch the operating system.
Two containment rules define the design
no module other than src/net/ may include a socket header, and the
check is enforced on every push; and the radio interface mirrors the
production modem's API, so replacing the simulation changes nothing
above it. The link to the ADA node is deliberately outside that
interface: it stays UDP on production hardware.
data — configuration, the message bindings, the event log;
logic — the four pipeline stages and the modem state machine;
control — main.cpp and the adapter, which mediate between the
There is no user interface: the event and capture streams are it.
